newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bond futures end little changed.
newsitem.headline: French bond futures end little changed.

text.p: 1530 GMT - Sept bond future ends little changed for second day in a row after trading in a narrow range, taking direction first from Bunds and then from U.S. bonds. PIBOR recovered some of lost ground as dollar retreated from recent highs.
*5.50 2007 OAT yield unch 5.47 pct. Bund spread -8 bp vs -9
*Call money unch at 3-1/8 1/4 pct. Sept PIBOR 96.50, up 1 bp
